about: The four hand-in screenshots for Vice Ledger (make.fun bounty gta6-trophy-guide-01), rendered from the app exactly as it ships under app/ — no mock-ups, no retouching. Produced by take-shots.mjs in this repo, which serves app/ itself, drives the Chrome Headless Shell at a 1280x800 viewport, and saves JPEGs that it verifies against the frame header and the 262,144-byte cap before accepting.

seed.note: One tracker record is seeded before the page loads so the shots show the tracker mid-use rather than empty: 14 of 55 trophies earned, the tracked counters partway up, and a player note on Maximum Withdrawal. Shots 1-3 use it with the spoiler shield off and hidden trophies revealed; shot 4 uses the same record with the spoiler shield on.

shots.shows: The trophy checklist with the seeded progress in the header card (14 / 55 earned) and the guide pane open on Maximum Withdrawal — its official description, the 3 / 5 bank-vaults counter, the guide text and the progress section.
The eight-stage roadmap to the platinum, each stage with its blurb, its earned/total tally and a chip per trophy, the seeded ones marked done.
The missables page: the eight trophies the guide flags as missable, each with its official description, the note explaining the risk, and a button through to its guide.

The same seeded record with the spoiler shield switched on and the Story kind filter active: earned story trophies keep their names, unearned ones collapse to a masked 'Shielded story trophy' row so nothing about the late story leaks.
shots.view: Checklist & guide, Story filter, spoiler shield on
